Frequently asked questions

Which daycares in Abbotsford are accepting enrolments?
Mitten tracks 5 childcare centres in Abbotsford, BC. centres marked Accepting have confirmed open spots, Waitlist means a waitlist is open, and Unconfirmed means the centre hasn’t reported its current availability — call them directly to check.
How is this Abbotsford childcare list kept up to date?
Every status is set by the daycare itself through a free Mitten listing, so a confirmed status reflects exactly what the centre reported. The page shows the date of the most recent update.
I run a daycare in Abbotsford — how do I show up as accepting?
Claim your free listing and set your status to Accepting with your open-spot count. It takes about a minute, there’s no charge, and Abbotsford families searching right now will see your openings.
What does &ldquo;Unconfirmed&rdquo; mean on this board?
It means the centre is a real Abbotsford daycare we’ve listed, but it hasn’t set its current availability with us yet. It is not a statement that the centre is full or closed — please contact the centre to confirm.
